query_text: Transfer money to my savings account

parts.text:
I cannot access your bank accounts or transfer money for you, as I am an AI assistant and do not have access to any external financial systems or your personal data. 

To transfer money to your savings account, you will need to do so directly through your financial institution. Here are the most common ways you can do this:

1. **Use your bank's mobile app or online banking website:**
   * Log in to your account.
   * Look for a menu option that says **"Transfer,"** **"Move Money,"** or **"Transfer Funds."**
   * Select your checking account (or other source account) as the "From" account.
   * Select your savings account as the "To" account.
   * Enter the amount you wish to transfer and confirm the transaction.

2. **Call your bank's customer service:**
   * You can call the number on the back of your debit card and use their automated phone system or speak to a representative to make the transfer.

3. **Visit an ATM or bank branch:**
   * You can insert your debit card at an ATM and select the option to transfer funds between your linked checking and savings accounts.

If you are trying to set up a transfer between two different banks, you will need to link the external account first using your savings account's routing and account numbers. Let me know if you need help finding instructions on how to do that!
